mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (in absolute terms) reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual inflation rate above 3.5% triggers market concerns about aggressive monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 370000 fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns occur in < 60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.0%), low unemployment signals strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform the baseline in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns occur in < 60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% annually signals economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) indicate a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., negative returns occur in < 60% of cases) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST above 1400 thousand units) signal sustained consumer confidence and economic resilience, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1400 fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances (i.e., positive returns occur in < 60% of cases) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
